next_session_set.summary: Make report-baseline aggregate capture lock-free (decouple the ACE-OLEDB query from the COM design-view spec read), then capture the golden reports-baseline corpus and wire decision #7's regression gate + READ-ME-FIRST.

blockers: Golden corpus capture (decision #7) is blocked: AccessReportSpecReader.ReadSpec opens each report in hidden design view, escalating the DB to an exclusive lock that collides with the concurrent ACE OLEDB aggregate query (OleDbReportQueryExecutor). Reproduced twice; manifested as an indefinite hang in S3. Fix is invasive (phase-decoupling or no-COM aggregates) and was escalated to the maintainer, who approved deferral to the follow-up set rather than an in-closeout refactor.
